title: OpenEval: Benchmarking Chinese LLMs across Capability, Alignment and Safety
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmarks focus on capability (NLP tasks, disciplinary knowledge, commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning), alignment (bias, offensiveness, illegality), and safety (power-seeking, self-awareness).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
